Software Glitch Caused Major Air Traffic Control Outage

A "millisecond" software error caused a widespread air traffic control system outage that grounded thousands of flights. The incident, described as a "software defect," led to significant flight disruptions. The exact nature of the error is still under investigation, but it is understood to have occurred within the air traffic control software.
